options: An invisible area around a magnet where magnetic forces act on other magnets or moving charges
A visible line drawn around a magnet
A force that only acts on stationary objects
questions.why: The script says a magnetic field is an invisible area around a magnet where magnetic forces act.

questions.q: According to the video, what can the field strength near a strong MRI machine be?
questions.why: The script states that near a strong MRI machine it can be 1.5 tesla.

questions.q: A charge of 1 coulomb moves at 1 meter per second perpendicular to a 1 tesla field. What is the force?
questions.why: Using F = q v B sin(θ) gives (1 C)(1 m/s)(1 T) sin(90°) = 1 N.
